use BookStack\Users\Models\Role;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class AdminRecipients
{
    protected bool $roleLoaded = false;
    protected ?Role $adminRole = null;

    /**
     * Get the users that hold the admin system role.
     * Returns an empty collection if no such role exists.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, \BookStack\Users\Models\User>
     */
    public function get(): Collection
    {
        $role = $this->getAdminRole();

        return $role ? $role->users()->get() : new Collection();
    }

    {
        if (!$this->roleLoaded) {
            $this->adminRole = Role::query()->where('system_name', '=', 'admin')->first();
            $this->roleLoaded = true;
        }

        return $this->adminRole;
